name: 清华笑傲江湖
english_description: A Tsinghua University take on Jin Yong's The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, sharing the TMI-2/ES2/Falcon engine family with sibling games xo and xo_final in this collection but built with independently developed sects and story content, centered on the 'Nanyang' region map and noticeably more compact than the xo series. New character names are filtered against a blocklist of Jin Yong novel character names, so players can't register as the original book's own protagonists. Combat writing is unusually detailed, with distinct flavor text for hits, parries, and dodges.
